description: This file contains implementation code for merging Git notes, including functions for diffing notes, handling conflicts, and performing merge operations with options for manual resolution and committing the merge. It manages notes merge state, reads and writes notes to a worktree, and integrates with the Git object database.
external_methods: interpretation of various diff and repository functions, e.g., repo_diff_setup, diff_tree_oid, diffcore_std, get_commit_tree_oid, etc.

methods.name: void init_notes_merge_options(struct repository * r,struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Initializes a notes_merge_options structure with default values, setting the repository pointer and preparing the commit message buffer.

methods.name: int path_to_oid(const char * path,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts a file path representing a note (with SHA1 hex prefix) into an object_id structure.

methods.name: int verify_notes_filepair(struct diff_filepair * p,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Validates a diff_filepair for notes, ensuring correct modes and OID presence, and extracts an object ID based on the file path.

methods.name: struct:notes_merge_pair * find_notes_merge_pair_pos(struct notes_merge_pair * list,int len,struct object_id * obj,int insert_new,int * occupied)
methods.description: Finds the position of an object ID in a sorted list of notes_merge_pairs, with optional insertion of new entries.

methods.name: struct:notes_merge_pair * diff_tree_remote(struct notes_merge_options * o,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * remote,int * num_changes)
methods.description: Computes the diff between a base and remote object ID, returning a list of change pairs for notes.

methods.name: void diff_tree_local(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * changes,int len,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * local)
methods.description: Computes the diff between a base and local object ID, updating existing change pairs with local changes.

methods.name: void check_notes_merge_worktree(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Ensures that the notes merge worktree directory exists and is properly set up, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: void write_buf_to_worktree(const struct object_id * obj,const char * buf,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Writes a buffer of data to a file in the notes merge worktree corresponding to a specific object ID.

methods.name: void write_note_to_worktree(const struct object_id * obj,const struct object_id * note)
methods.description: Reads a note object and writes it to the worktree for manual conflict resolution.

methods.name: int ll_merge_in_worktree(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p)
methods.description: Performs a three-way merge of note blobs in the worktree with internal merge logic.

methods.name: int merge_one_change_manual(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Handles merging a single note change manually, resolving conflicts by writing appropriate notes or merge results to the worktree.

methods.name: int merge_one_change(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * p,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Merges a single note change according to the specified merge strategy, handling conflicts appropriately.

methods.name: int merge_changes(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_merge_pair * changes,int * num_changes,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Merges a list of note changes, resolving conflicts based on merge base, local, and remote states, and possibly invoking manual merge.

methods.name: int merge_from_diffs(struct notes_merge_options * o,const struct object_id * base,const struct object_id * local,const struct object_id * remote,struct notes_tree * t)
methods.description: Coordinates diff-based merging process for notes, computing remote and local differences, and merging them into a notes tree.

methods.name: int notes_merge(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * local_tree,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Performs a merge of two notes references (local and remote), creating a resulting notes commit, handling merge bases, fast-forwards, and conflicts.

methods.name: int notes_merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * partial_tree,struct commit * partial_commit,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Finalizes a notes merge by reading files from the worktree, creating a new commit with combined notes, and cleaning up the merge worktree.

methods.name: int notes_merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing notes merge by removing all files from the notes merge worktree, allowing the user to restart or cancel the merge.
